Description: Vehicles › „Neues Fahrzeug“ stores a car typed from its registration certificate as checked by hand and puts it in the vehicle selector at once; without its axle loads the form says before saving what that means, and the car waits under „Zur Prüfung“ until they are entered.

Solved differently, as your demo file is not with us: the import reads any CSV or Excel file, you map its columns once per source, a dry run shows what would be new, changed or refused before any car is imported, and cars typed by hand or taken from a Gutachten are never overwritten; please send us your demo file so we can check the mapping against it.
Together with 201, the form has every field of your list, each labelled with its number in the papers (2.1, 2.2, D.1, D.3, D.2, K, P.2, 8.1, 8.2, T).

A rim can no longer be created in the form or published without its Radtypenbezeichnung; rims saved before, and new ones from a supplier file without that column, still save and are gathered in the rim list under „Radtypenbezeichnung: Fehlt noch“ for you to fill in.
The field is now called „Radtypenbezeichnung“ and is part of the rim’s name, in the shop and in the rim’s heading in the admin.

In the shop a rim is now named brand + model + Radtypenbezeichnung — on cards, the product page, the basket, new orders and the RIMIFY-Check — once its Radtypenbezeichnung is entered and no other title is typed under „Titel im Shop“, so a customer can find it in the Gutachten.

Each size is now „Verfügbar“ or „Nicht verfügbar“ instead of a stock count; an unavailable size shows „Anfrage“ instead of the basket button, on its card and its page, and opens the contact form filled in with the rim, size, ET and the chosen car.

Built and tested on our test shop. On your preview the section is there, but the example ABE 55255 predates it and has no combinations entered, and entering them needs a draft, which our tests never create there: enter your document’s combinations in a draft to see the shop offer only those.
Built and tested on our test shop. On your preview the two fields open only in a draft Gutachten’s entry form, and our tests create no drafts there: open one of your drafts to see them.

Catalogue › Reifen holds each tyre as one size of one profile with its EU tyre label, price and availability, a tyre goes into a complete wheel only while it is available and its label is complete, and one click lists the tyres whose label is still incomplete.
Articles now also take an „HTML-Abschnitt“ limited to the agreed list (headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, links, images, bold, italic); everything else is removed on save and again on output.
The Ratgeber has its own admin page under Inhalte › Ratgeber with search, sorting, create, edit, publish, withdraw and delete; old addresses redirect there, and /blog lists every published article.

The title composes itself from brand, model and Radtypenbezeichnung; a title typed otherwise under „Titel im Shop“ stays, the rim list flags it „Titel weicht ab“, and in the form the composed title is one click away.

Every rim page carries structured data for Google (JSON-LD), each size and colour a product of its own with SKU, EAN, price and availability, ratings only from real reviews and the shipping cost once you have entered it under Einstellungen › Verkäufer & Versand; delivery time and returns are not in it yet.

Solved differently: the table is shown, and required at release, only on a Gutachten that according to its entered details prints one — like ABE 55255, where it decides the tyres for cars above 210 km/h — and everywhere else it folds to one line, „Keine Tabelle hinterlegt“.

The shop tells the browser and the host not to store its pages, so every change to the catalogue applies at once, and a page brought back with the Back button checks with the shop and reloads if anything changed.

Part 1 is done: the shop no longer creates, numbers or mentions its own invoices, and older ones stay readable; Stripe invoices with every line and 19 % VAT, and the daily copy to S3, come with the next release.

The order link now carries a random UUID and keeps its signature; a link with the order number finds nothing. Order numbers look like 2610-10487 everywhere, Stripe included, and the admin search finds them with or without the dash, old RMF numbers too.

Each Gutachten now takes its Bereifungskombinationen per EG-Typgenehmigungsnummer: choose the vehicle type and enter its list, copy another number’s list with „Kombinationen kopieren von …“, or put one combination on several numbers with „Auf mehrere EG-Nummern anwenden“; in the shop a car gets the list of the number its field K falls under, never more loosely than the Gutachten prints it, and „Noch nicht bestätigt“ where none does.
